page.title: Walk around the campus like in a game
page.lead: A keyboard-controlled avatar, with the camera behind it, that doesn't go through buildings or leave the map. Switch to orbital view to see the campus from above.
page.heading: Heading
page.keysMove: W or ↑: forward · S or ↓: back
page.keysTurn: A or ←: turn left · D or →: turn right
page.keysOrbital: In Orbital mode: drag to rotate and use the wheel (or pinch) to zoom.
page.touchNote: On touch screens the demo opens in Orbital mode: the avatar can't walk by touch yet.
